correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed Sun telescoping identity S_n(X)=n^2 sum_{j<n}B_nj^2 X^j/(2j+1). For n=p^a, p odd, only denominator j=(n-1)/2 reaches p^a; B is a p-adic unit, yielding coefficientwise mod p^{a+1} congruence. At x=pu, normalized polynomial F_{p,a}(u) is 1 mod p for p>=5 and 1+u mod 3 for p=3; Hensel and unit difference quotient give unique 3-adic zero and exact valuation/root counts. Fixed-divisor argument uses S_n(0)=n^2 and S_n(1) with valuation a; dyadic denominators are odd. Independent direct/closed coefficient and residue-class counts were checked at (p,a)=(3,1),(3,2),(5,1),(7,1).
